# Trader Cockpit

> Educational guides to backtesting and trading strategy validation: out-of-sample testing, Monte Carlo analysis, walk-forward analysis, drawdown and selection bias. Trader Cockpit is a Windows desktop app for trading strategy research, in early access. Nothing here is financial advice.

The guides are written by the Trader Cockpit team. Examples use synthetic data and are not performance results.

## Start here

- [In-Sample vs Out-of-Sample Backtesting](https://trader-cockpit.com/learn/concepts/out-of-sample.html): what counts as unseen data and how a holdout becomes part of the selection
- [Monte Carlo Simulation for Trading Strategies](https://trader-cockpit.com/learn/concepts/monte-carlo.html): what reshuffling and resampling trades can test, and their limits
- [Trading Strategy Backtest Checklist](https://trader-cockpit.com/strategy-claim-audit-checklist.html): questions to ask about any published backtest result

## How to do it in the app

- [How to Backtest a Strategy Without Code](https://trader-cockpit.com/how-to/backtest-a-strategy-without-code.html): Backtest without writing code: save a market, enter your real costs, let Builder search rule combinations, then read every trade before you trust a result.
- [How to Robustness Test a Trading Strategy](https://trader-cockpit.com/how-to/robustness-test-a-trading-strategy.html): Run a strategy through held-back dates, other markets, other timeframes, worse slippage and Monte Carlo, in order, and see why each weak one dropped out.
- [How to Walk-Forward Test a Trading Strategy](https://trader-cockpit.com/how-to/walk-forward-test-a-strategy.html): Walk-forward testing re-fits a strategy on one window and trades it on the next, over and over. How to set the windows, run it and read the score.
- [How to Backtest Pine Script on Your Own Data](https://trader-cockpit.com/how-to/backtest-pine-script-on-your-own-data.html): Run a Pine strategy on your own bars: put the data on a chart, open the Pine Script panel, paste the script and read the Strategy Tester’s list of trades.
- [How to Export a Strategy to Pine Script](https://trader-cockpit.com/how-to/export-a-strategy-to-pine-script.html): Take a strategy you built without code to TradingView: retest it on bar-close timing, save it as Pine Script v6, and see why an export can be refused.
- [How to Test a Strategy Against Prop Firm Rules](https://trader-cockpit.com/how-to/test-a-strategy-against-prop-firm-rules.html): Replay your backtested trades against a futures prop firm challenge: profit target, maximum loss, daily loss limit and days to pass, with a pass chance.
- [How to Read a Footprint Chart](https://trader-cockpit.com/how-to/read-a-footprint-chart.html): A footprint chart shows what traded at each price inside a bar, split into selling and buying. Turn one on for Bitcoin and other crypto and read it row by row.
- [How to Paper Trade Crypto on Live Prices](https://trader-cockpit.com/how-to/paper-trade-crypto.html): Paper trade Bitcoin and other crypto on live prices with simulated money and no exchange account: market, limit and stop orders, exits, and an account record.
- [How to Import CSV Price Data for Backtesting](https://trader-cockpit.com/how-to/import-price-data-from-csv.html): Bring your own price history into the app: import a CSV, TSV or TradingView chart export, set the time zone, save it and use it in charts and backtests.
- [How to Turn a Trading Idea Into a Strategy](https://trader-cockpit.com/how-to/turn-a-trading-idea-into-a-strategy.html): Describe a trading idea in plain words and get a strategy you can backtest. Apollo drafts the rules and fills in Builder’s settings. You approve every change.
